topic: From gaming all summer to running a real weekend business
caption:
Last summer my son played 8 hours a day. This summer he has three regular clients and made $220 in July.

HustleUp walks teens through finding a real skill, pricing it, and getting their first customer.

It's not about the money. It's about the look on their face when they earn it.

Give them a head start → hustleup.us
